[LUNI.15.2] The standard library's unit modules. An author imports the modules
a program needs.

| Module | Contents |
|---|---|
| `units.si` | SI base + prefixed forms + derived |
| `units.metric` | litre, tonne, bar, eV, etc. |
| `units.customary` | US: inch, foot, mile, lb, psi, liquid and dry measure… |
| `units.imperial` | UK: stone, long ton, UK gallon… |
| `units.avoirdupois` | grain, oz, lb, short/long ton |
| `units.troy` | troy oz, troy lb, pennyweight |
| `units.electrical` | gauss, maxwell (CGS EM); SI EM units in `units.si` |
| `units.chemistry` | molar, pH, ppm, ppb… |
| `units.audio` | dB family, dBm↔watt, MIDI↔Hz, sone, phon |
| `units.nautical` | nautical mile, knot, fathom |
| `units.time` | week, fortnight, year variants |
| `units.physics` | torque, rpm, viscosity, CGS legacy |
| `units.astro` | ly, pc, jansky, solar mass (IAU 2015) |
| `units.computer` | data, data_rate, baud, energy_per_bit… |
